⇄ SAME BAYS — SISTER BAY GROUPS
COLOR GROUP
Pick a color, then click bays to assign them to that sister group. Click a bay again to remove it. Changes are saved with the project.
BAYS
SUMMARY
⧉ BAY COPY TOOL
Uses sister bay groups — assign colors via SETTINGS → SAME BAYS
SISTER BAY GROUPS
Each color group = one SOURCE bay (solid border) copies TO all other bays in the same group (dashed border). Click any bay to toggle it as source.
SOURCE BAY — select the bay to copy FROM
TARGET BAYS — select bays to copy TO
No target bays selected
COPY CONTENTS — choose what to include
✎ BAY NAMING TOOL
BAY NAMES
Leave blank to use auto-number (02, 06, 10…)
⬡ HC NAMING TOOL
HC NAMES PER BAY — leave blank to use default (HC 1, HC 2 …)
Typical formats: HC 1 P  ·  HC 1 C  ·  HC 1 S  ·  1 (P)  ·  1 (CP)  ·  1 (CS)  ·  1 (S)
SELECT NAMING PATTERN
+ MIDDLE GROUP (M) — adds a Middle bay between each Forward/Aft pair (3-bay cycle)
B02: 1 (F)  →  B06: 1 M (F)  →  B10: 1 (A)  →  B14: 2 (F)  →  B18: 2 M (F)  →  B22: 2 (A) …
Edit names · Tab to move · Enter to update
⬛ BLOCK MANAGER
VESSEL BLOCKS — place ACCOMMODATION or ENGINE ROOM blocks between bays
The block spans the full port-to-starboard width of the vessel and is separated from adjacent bays by the standard bay gap. One block per gap position.
▤ PLATFORM MANAGER
PLATFORMS — add a platform forward or aft of any bay
NEW PLATFORM
Platform will be auto-named in fwd→aft order (P1, P2 …)

⚙ OPTIONS
GENERAL
Placement speed / responsiveness Minimum time between placements — applies to all objects (lashing eyes, foundations, stoppers, flexipads, resting pads). Increase to avoid accidental double-placement.
Auto-save interval Automatically saves to the current file. Only works when a file is already open.
Auto-backup interval Saves a temporary backup file to your Downloads folder at the chosen interval. Use this to recover work if something goes wrong — the backup file can be reopened at any time. Works even without a file open.
APPEARANCE
HC shape border color When ON, all hatch cover outlines (normal and free-drawn) are drawn in black regardless of HC color
HC panel color When OFF, no fill color or shade is applied inside hatch cover frames — frames are drawn in black outline only
Bay background
Canvas background grid Blueprint grid lines shown on the canvas area surrounding the vessel / bay panel. Turn OFF if the grid disappears on its own — then turn ON to restore it.
FLOATING ICONS
Show or hide individual floating action buttons on the canvas
